name: Ioan Hefin
biography: Ioan Hefin is a Welsh actor, writer and director in theatre, film and radio. He made his debut at the Edinburgh Fringe in 1986. He was educated at Ysgol Gynradd Mynydd y Garreg, Ysgol Ramadeg Caerfyrddin and Cardiff University.
